notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing. Two WebSearch queries plus cached pages yield only name, county, coordinates, standing status and OSM elevation. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, access or rental source found. Record matches FFLA and OSM on name, county, location and status; no corrections proposed. Lead not used: a search snippet described a Town of Lawrence tower south of Glen Flora in an undated Rusk County ranger-station document, but the cached copy of the page it linked (a UW-Madison library page) does not contain that text, so it is not cited and may or may not be this tower. Search also returned TopoQuest Lawrence Townhall (a building, not the tower); not used. WXPR and FFLA 2019 items are statewide context only. Leads: Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory, WDNR tower divestment records, Rusk County Historical Society. Confirm land ownership before any access advice.
